notes.title: Arcade Mode Overhaul!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683768/d52f1c29becf1b47757db8a65b9ab683a7d7f8ec.png[/img]

We've recently updated various aspects of Tomb of Anubi0s. We're proud to add a tutorial and some balance changes for the arcade mode!
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial for The Cistern.
[*] Added icons for keyboard, Xbox one, Xbox 360, PS5 and PS4 gamepads.
[*] Farseer turret cooldown time increased to from 40 ticks to 80 ticks (1 second, 60 ticks).
[*] Rebalanced Arcade mode: deeply increased the frequency and variety of waves.
[*] Added alternate movement input for keyboard: ASDW and Arrow keys.
[*] Shotgun cooldown reduced from 45 ticks to 30 ticks.
[*] Shotgun heat consumption reduced from 20 to 16.
[*] Reduced Rocket damage from 4 to 3.
[*] Reduced Triple Rocker damage from 3.5 to 2.5.
[*] Reduced Heavy Rocket damage from 8 to 5.
[*] Flying enemies now ignore you if you're overheated.
[*] Fixed Ram's Vision additional laser beams not disappearing when target dies.
[*] Fixed crash when pausing right before a game lose / game win screen.
[*] Removed Cistern left cascade tower got its background platform.
[*] Removed debug key event that would make you instantly lose.
[/list]
